rule: tools/readings.py three_run_reading: a change of 0.5% or more, the mean of the three runs' changes in percent of native, reads by the gauge's aim; under it STEADY, under the floor; every run's two values equal to 1e-09 of the value, STEADY, the same; runs that moved 0.5% or more in opposite directions, the runs disagree. Evidence strength is shown beside the word and never changes it: strong, every run the mean's way and beyond its noise (its 95% interval clear of zero); moderate, all but one; weak, one run beyond its noise; inconclusive, no run beyond its noise (a mean of 0.5% or more, not a change any one run could tell from its noise). STEADY is of three kinds: exactly the same (every run's values equal to nine decimal places), under the floor (a measured change, the three runs' mean under 0.5%) and no difference beyond the noise (a table read by an older key). The runs disagree is unresolved, never a final word: opposite directions each beyond its noise, or opposite directions inside overlapping noise.
